staging: hidden per-spec partial directory containing spec-hash prefix
publication: completion inventory with byte sizes and SHA256, then atomic directory rename
durability: copy to distinct durable root followed by source/destination size and SHA256 equality
resume_rule: skip only exact spec identity in COMPLETE_VALIDATED_DURABLE; reject spec-hash drift
partial_rule: fail closed for validation/quarantine; never silently overwrite
retry_rule: identical frozen spec and seed only
